title: upready.owner-summary/v1 — GET /tenants/owner/summary, the «Сводка» page of the owner's panel
description: t-2026-10-20-23. What the panel's backend answers on either instance: every sales source of the owner fetched for this page load — the sources of this instance read locally, the sources of the other instance asked through the relay at that moment (each a shop-summary/v1) — and the totals across the sources that answered. Totals are in rubles (Ivan 21.10, marks 17, 19, 20 on prototype v2: «валюту нужно показывать одну … в рублях», «в поповере показывать уже список валют»): every amount in another currency is converted at the rate its source sent in shop-summary/v1 `fx`, and `by_currency` keeps the real amounts with their rates for the popover. This shape never leaves the instance that computes it; only shop-summary/v1 crosses.

current_tenant_id.description: The shop the panel is open on; the «…» menu marks it.

display_currency.description: The one currency of every figure the page shows.

rate_source.description: Whose rates converted the other currencies: cbr = the Bank of Russia.

source.description: storefront or a marketplace account of the shop; one row of «Источники продаж» per (tenant_id, source).

state.description: Totals are fetched when the page loads, never served from a cache (Ivan 20.10, mark 6 on prototype v1). ok: the source answered, summary holds its totals; no_answer: its instance did not answer within the page's time limit, summary is null and the row says so; not_connected: the source belongs to the owner but is not linked yet (a .com shop before its first sign-in through RU), summary is null.

fetched_at.description: When the totals were computed for this page load; null unless state is ok.

total.description: One period across the sources that answered, in the display currency.

previous_revenue.description: The period of the same length just before, converted at the same rates.

aov.description: revenue / order_count, rounded to a ruble.

by_currency.description: The real amounts behind the total, one row per currency the sources sold in: the revenue popover lists them.

rate.description: Rubles for one unit, from the sources' fx; null for the display currency itself.

rate_date.description: The day the rate was set for; null for the display currency.

revenue_converted.description: revenue × rate, rounded to a ruble per source.

shops.description: How many sources hold this currency in the period.
